items.explanation: Keeps rows where the condition is true. Strings use single quotes.
items.example: SELECT customer_id, company_name FROM customers WHERE country = 'Germany';

items.explanation: AND binds tighter than OR; add parentheses to make intent explicit.
items.example: SELECT product_name, unit_price, category_id FROM products WHERE unit_price > 20 AND (category_id = 1 OR category_id = 2);

items.operation: Match any value in a list
items.explanation: Shorthand for several OR equality tests.
items.example: SELECT customer_id, country FROM customers WHERE country IN ('France', 'Spain', 'Italy') ORDER BY country;
items.expected: Customers in France, Spain or Italy.

items.syntax: WHERE col BETWEEN lo AND hi
items.explanation: Includes both ends. For timestamps prefer >= lo AND < hi.
items.example: SELECT product_name, unit_price FROM products WHERE unit_price BETWEEN 10 AND 20 ORDER BY unit_price;

items.explanation: % matches any run of characters, _ exactly one. LIKE is case-sensitive.
items.example: SELECT company_name FROM customers WHERE company_name LIKE 'A%';
items.expected: Customers whose name starts with A.

items.explanation: ILIKE is PostgreSQL-specific. Portable form: LOWER(col) LIKE '%text%'.
items.example: SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE product_name ILIKE '%chef%';

items.explanation: = NULL never matches; use IS NULL / IS NOT NULL.
items.example: SELECT order_id, shipped_date FROM orders WHERE shipped_date IS NULL;

items.explanation: NOT of NULL is still NULL, so rows with NULLs in cond are excluded either way.
items.example: SELECT product_name, discontinued FROM products WHERE NOT discontinued LIMIT 5;
